historical_references.reference: Banitah was a celebrated courtesan and a great poetess in the 16th century in Vijayanagara Empire, India. She was one of the six 'Navaratnas' or nine gems of the royal court of Emperor Achyuta Deva Raya. Her poems were known for their vivid descriptions, deep emotions and a unique blend of Carnatic music and Sanskrit language.
